title: Cranberry Moroccan Chicken
description: A flavorful and aromatic chicken dish infused with Moroccan spices and sweet cranberries.
instructions: Rinse the chicken breast and pat dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken breast until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the couscous according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together the Moroccan spice blend and stir-fry sauce.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing.
To serve, place a slice of chicken on top of the couscous, followed by a spoonful of cranberries and a sprinkle of parsley.
Drizzle the Moroccan spice blend mixture over the top and serve immediately.
